def transform(grid):
    # Each 0 marker is a corner/endpoint; extend from marker in aligned rows/columns
    # to the other markers, painting the connecting line in color 2.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    marks = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Join aligned marker pairs, covering intervening background only.
    for i,(r,c) in enumerate(marks):
        for rr,cc in marks[i+1:]:
            if r == rr or c == cc:
                dr = (rr > r) - (rr < r); dc = (cc > c) - (cc < c)
                steps=max(abs(rr-r),abs(cc-c))
                for k in range(1,steps):
                    y,x=r+dr*k,c+dc*k
                    if grid[y][x]==bg: out[y][x]=2
    return out
PY
